nodes.description: msg.sender: caller-controlled address used for authorization in Permissions/Ownable, ValidatorService, DelegationController and Distributor.
block.timestamp (now): miner-influenced time used for bounty windows, lockups, rotation delays and schain creation.
Address.sendValue low-level recipient.call{value: amount}("") forwarding all gas.
ECDSA.recover uses the ecrecover opcode to derive a signer; malleability guarded by s/v range checks.
Punisher.slash performs external call delegationController.confiscate before emitting the Slash event.
Punisher._getAndUpdateLockedAmount triggers delegationController.processAllSlashes(wallet) external call.
DelegationController._sendSlashingSignals performs external call punisher.handleSlash(holder, penalty).
SkaleManager._payBounty performs external call IMintableToken.mint on the SkaleToken contract.
Distributor.withdrawBounty performs external call skaleToken.transfer(to, bounty).
SchainsInternal._generateGroup uses blockhash(block.number-1) as pseudo-random source for node selection.
NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup uses blockhash(block.number-1) as pseudo-random source for node selection.
Nodes._setNodeLeaving / _setNodeLeft decrement numberOfActiveNodes/numberOfLeavingNodes without SafeMath (0.6.10 wraps).
BokkyPooBahsDateTimeLibrary.subYears performs unchecked 'year -= _years' which can underflow.
OwnableUpgradeSafe._owner: privileged owner address controlling administrative functions.
AccessControlUpgradeSafe._roles: role membership mapping used for hasRole authorization.
ContractManager.contracts: mapping name-hash to contract address, source of all external contract resolution.
Punisher._locked: per-holder slashed/locked token amounts.
TokenLaunchLocker._locked: per-holder launch-locked token amounts.
SchainsInternal.schains / schainsGroups / schainsForNodes: schain ownership and node-group storage.
SchainsInternal.usedSchainNames / numberOfSchains: name uniqueness and schain counter.
Nodes.nodes / spaceOfNodes / spaceToNodes: node records and free-space bookkeeping.
NodeRotation.rotations / waitForNewNode: per-schain rotation state and freeze timers.
DelegationController.delegations and _delegatedToValidator/_effectiveDelegatedToValidator sequences.
Distributor._bountyPaid / _feePaid / _firstUnwithdrawnMonth: accumulated bounty and fee accounting.
BountyV2._epochPool / _nextEpoch / _bountyWasPaidInCurrentEpoch: epoch reward accounting.
ValidatorService._trustedValidators / trustedValidatorsList: whitelist of authorized validators.
ConstantsHolder.launchTimestamp and related economic constants.
KeyStorage._schainsPublicKeys / _publicKeysInProgress: BLS common public keys per schain.
TokenState._lockers: list of ILocker contracts aggregated for locked amounts.
Address.sendValue(address payable recipient, uint256 amount): sends native value via low-level call.
ECDSA.recover(bytes32 hash, bytes signature): recovers signer with malleability checks.
Permissions.allow(string contractName): permits caller if resolved contract or owner.
Permissions.onlyOwner / OwnableUpgradeSafe.onlyOwner: restricts to owner/admin.
Permissions.onlyAdmin: restricts to SkaleManager ADMIN_ROLE or owner.
Punisher.slash(uint validatorId, uint amount): slashing entrypoint guarded by allow("SkaleDKG").
Punisher.forgive(address holder, uint amount): admin forgiveness reducing _locked.
Punisher.handleSlash(address holder, uint amount): adds to _locked, callable by DelegationController.
Punisher._getAndUpdateLockedAmount(address wallet): processes slashes and returns locked amount.
Schains.addSchain(address from, uint deposit, bytes data): creates an schain, guarded by allow("SkaleManager").
Schains.deleteSchain(address from, string name): removes schain, iterating node group, calls addSpace.
Schains.deleteSchainByRoot(string name): admin removal of an existing schain.
Schains.restartSchainCreation(string name): recreates schain group after DKG failure.
SchainsInternal.initializeSchain(...): stores schain owner, startDate/block and name, allow("Schains").
SchainsInternal.removeSchain(bytes32 schainId, address from): deactivates and deletes schain, decrements counter.
SchainsInternal.removeNodeFromSchain(uint nodeIndex, bytes32 schainHash): splices node out of group, allowThree.
SchainsInternal._generateGroup: pseudo-randomly builds node group from blockhash and mutates space.
SchainsInternal.addSchainForNode(uint nodeIndex, bytes32 schainId): adds schain to node list, allowTwo.
SchainsInternal.removeSchainForNode(uint nodeIndex, uint schainIndex): removes schain from node, allowThree.
SkaleManager.tokensReceived(...): ERC777 hook that forwards to Schains.addSchain when userData present.
SkaleManager.getBounty(uint nodeIndex): validates node and pays bounty through _payBounty.
SkaleManager._payBounty(uint bounty, uint validatorId): mints tokens to Distributor.
TokenLaunchLocker.lock(address holder, uint amount): increases launch lock, allow("TokenLaunchManager").
TokenLaunchLocker.getAndUpdateLockedAmount(address): proof-of-use unlock logic using now.
TokenState.addLocker(string locker): owner-restricted addition of locker contract.
TokenState.removeLocker(string locker): owner-restricted removal of locker contract.
ValidatorService.registerValidator(...): registers caller as validator, sets fee rate and MDA.
ValidatorService.linkNodeAddress(address nodeAddress, bytes sig): validates signed binding of node address.
ValidatorService.confirmNewAddress(uint validatorId): confirms address change when msg.sender is owner.
ValidatorService._setValidatorAddress: swaps validator address in _validatorAddressToId mapping.
ValidatorService.removeNodeAddress(uint validatorId, address nodeAddress): allowTwo guarded unlink.
BountyV2.calculateBounty(uint nodeIndex): computes and debits epoch pool bounty, time-gated.
BountyV2.handleDelegationAdd(uint validatorId, uint amount, uint month): updates effective delegated sum.
BountyV2.handleDelegationRemoving(uint validatorId, uint amount, uint month): removes delegated sum.
ConstantsHolder.setLaunchTimestamp(uint): owner-only setting of network launch time.
ConstantsHolder.setMSR(uint): owner-only setting of minimum staking requirement.
DelegationController.delegate(...): creates delegation proposal, checks token balance and slashing.
DelegationController.confiscate(uint validatorId, uint amount): reduces stake, allow("Punisher").
DelegationController.acceptPendingDelegation(uint): validator accepts and statistics are added.
DelegationController.requestUndelegation(uint): removes delegation amounts, processes slashes.
DelegationController._sendSlashingSignals: aggregates penalties and calls Punisher.handleSlash.
getAndUpdateEffectiveDelegatedToValidator(uint validatorId, uint month): allowTwo("Bounty","Distributor").
getAndUpdateDelegatedToValidatorNow(uint): used by Nodes MSR checks.
DelegationPeriodManager.setDelegationPeriod(uint monthsCount, uint stakeMultiplier): owner-only.
Distributor.withdrawBounty(uint validatorId, address to): time-gated transfer of earned bounty.
Distributor.withdrawFee(address to): time-gated transfer of validator fees.
Distributor.tokensReceived(...): ERC777 hook distributing minted bounty to validator.
getAndUpdateEarnedBountyAmountOf(address wallet, uint validatorId): computes earned bounty.
NodeRotation.exitFromSchain(uint nodeIndex): rotates node off schain when free nodes exist.
NodeRotation.rotateNode(uint nodeIndex, bytes32 schainId, bool shouldDelay): allowTwo rotation.
NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup(bytes32 schainId): blockhash-random node selection, allowThree.
NodeRotation.skipRotationDelay(bytes32 schainIndex): owner-only immediate rotation.
NodeRotation._startRotation: sets freezeUntil = now + rotationDelay and waitForNewNode.
Monitors.sendVerdict(uint fromMonitorIndex, Verdict verdict): time-sensitive verdict recording.
Monitors.calculateMetrics(uint nodeIndex): computes median downtime/latency from verdicts.
TimeHelpers.getCurrentMonth(): derives current month index from block.timestamp.
TimeHelpers.calculateProofOfUseLockEndTime(uint month, uint lockUpPeriodDays): time math.
KeyStorage.finalizePublicKey(bytes32 schainId): commits in-progress public key, allow("SkaleDKG").
KeyStorage.adding(bytes32 schainId, G2Point value): accumulates DKG public key share, allow("SkaleDKG").
Nodes.removeSpaceFromNode(uint nodeIndex, uint8 space): allowTwo guarded space management.
Nodes.checkPossibilityCreatingNode(address): enforces MSR and validator authorization.
Nodes.checkPossibilityToMaintainNode(uint validatorId, uint nodeIndex): MSR check for bounty reduction.
Nodes.completeExit(uint nodeIndex): finalizes node exit, deletes node, updates BountyV2.
Nodes._setNodeLeaving(uint nodeIndex): flips status and mutates active/leaving counters.
OwnableUpgradeSafe.transferOwnership(address newOwner): onlyOwner ownership transfer.
OwnableUpgradeSafe.renounceOwnership(): onlyOwner renounce of ownership.
BokkyPooBahsDateTimeLibrary.subYears(uint timestamp, uint _years): unchecked year subtraction.

amount parameter of Punisher.slash.

schainId parameter of NodeRotation.selectNodeToGroup.

nodeIndex parameter of SchainsInternal.removeNodeFromSchain.

edges.reason: Permissions.allow compares msg.sender against resolved contract address or owner.
onlyOwner compares msg.sender against the owner/admin role.
onlyAdmin passes msg.sender into _isAdmin for role evaluation.
msg.sender is the account key queried in _roles membership checks.
registerValidator binds msg.sender as the validator owner address.
linkNodeAddress requires the recovered signer to equal nodeAddress and caller to be the validator.
confirmNewAddress requires msg.sender to equal requestedAddress.
delegate uses msg.sender as the token holder of the delegation.
acceptPendingDelegation authorizes msg.sender as the validator address.
calculateBounty requires now to be past the next reward timestamp.
TokenLaunchLocker unlock condition compares proof-of-use lock end time with now.
withdrawBounty requires now >= launchTimestamp + BOUNTY_LOCKUP_MONTHS.
withdrawFee requires now >= launchTimestamp + BOUNTY_LOCKUP_MONTHS.
completeExit emits and relies on block.timestamp for exit timing.
_startRotation sets freezeUntil = now + rotationDelay.
getCurrentMonth derives month index from block.timestamp.
addSchain requires now >= schainCreationTimeStamp.
initializeSchain sets startDate = block.timestamp and startBlock = block.number.
sendVerdict compares checked-node time and delta period against block.timestamp.
exitFromSchain depends on rotation freeze timing derived from block.timestamp.
slash is gated by allow("SkaleDKG").
initializeSchain is gated by allow("Schains").
removeNodeFromSchain is gated by allowThree.
addSchainForNode is gated by allowTwo.
removeSchainForNode is gated by allowThree.
selectNodeToGroup is gated by allowThree.
rotateNode is gated by allowTwo.
setLaunchTimestamp is onlyOwner.
setMSR is onlyOwner.
addLocker is onlyOwner.
removeLocker is onlyOwner.
transferOwnership is onlyOwner.
renounceOwnership is onlyOwner.
setDelegationPeriod is onlyOwner.
skipRotationDelay is onlyOwner.
forgive is onlyAdmin.
onlyOwner reads the _owner storage slot for comparison.
_isAdmin consults _roles through hasRole on SkaleManager and DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE.
sendValue performs a low-level call forwarding all gas to recipient payload.
slash makes the confiscate external call before emitting Slash.
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount triggers processAllSlashes on DelegationController.
_sendSlashingSignals calls punisher.handleSlash while iterating aggregated signals.
_payBounty performs an external mint call into the SkaleToken contract.
withdrawBounty performs skaleToken.transfer after updating accounting.
confiscate external call re-enters DelegationController state mutation of delegated sequences.
handleSlash external call re-enters Punisher and mutates _locked.
tokensReceived calls Schains.addSchain during the ERC777 transfer callback.
external token transfer interacts with Distributor bounty accounting state.
mint callback reaches Distributor.tokensReceived and updates _bountyPaid.
low-level value call can re-enter while Punisher locked amounts are mid-update.
slash external call ordering leaves _locked state transiently inconsistent with event emission.
_generateGroup derives selection randomness from blockhash(block.number-1).
selectNodeToGroup derives selection randomness from blockhash(block.number-1).
rotateNode calls selectNodeToGroup to pick the replacement node.
_generateGroup calls addSchainForNode for each chosen node.
_generateGroup calls Nodes.removeSpaceFromNode for each chosen node.
_generateGroup reads Nodes active node ids and node activity state.
_setNodeLeaving decrements numberOfActiveNodes and increments numberOfLeavingNodes without SafeMath.
subYears performs unchecked 'year -= _years' that can underflow in 0.6.x.
transferOwnership writes the new owner into _owner.
renounceOwnership clears _owner to address(0).
handleSlash adds the slashed amount into Punisher._locked.
forgive subtracts from or deletes Punisher._locked entries.
_getAndUpdateLockedAmount returns the holder's Punisher._locked balance.
lock adds the amount to TokenLaunchLocker._locked.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount reads and deletes TokenLaunchLocker._locked.
initializeSchain writes owner, lifetime, deposit and index into schains mapping.
removeSchain deletes the schain struct and swaps owner index list.
removeNodeFromSchain mutates schainsGroups and holesForSchains.
addSchainForNode pushes schain into schainsForNodes.
removeSchainForNode removes schain and records holesForNodes.
_generateGroup assigns schainsGroups[schainId] = nodesInGroup.
initializeSchain sets usedSchainNames[schainId] = true and increments numberOfSchains.
removeSchain decrements numberOfSchains and manipulates schainsAtSystem.
removeSpaceFromNode moves the node in spaceOfNodes/spaceToNodes.
completeExit deletes the node and its space entry from Nodes.
_startRotation writes nodeIndex, newNodeIndex and freezeUntil into rotations.
rotateNode updates rotations via _finishRotation and removes node from schain.
selectNodeToGroup reads schain space/exception state and marks the new node.
exitFromSchain reads rotations and active schain of the node.
delegate writes _delegatedByHolder and pending delegation records.
confiscate reduces _delegatedToValidator and _effectiveDelegatedToValidator sequences.
acceptPendingDelegation adds delegation statistics for new month.
requestUndelegation removes amounts from delegated sequences.
getAndUpdateEffectiveDelegatedToValidator reads the effective delegated sequence.
withdrawBounty reads and updates _firstUnwithdrawnMonth and bounty amounts.
calculateBounty debits _epochPool and increments _bountyWasPaidInCurrentEpoch.
setLaunchTimestamp writes ConstantsHolder.launchTimestamp.
calculateBounty reads ConstantsHolder.launchTimestamp for epoch reward gating.
finalizePublicKey commits _publicKeysInProgress into _schainsPublicKeys.
adding accumulates shares into _publicKeysInProgress.
addLocker pushes a new locker name into TokenState._lockers.
removeLocker splices the locker name out of TokenState._lockers.
slash resolves ValidatorService and DelegationController addresses from contractManager.contracts.
addSchain resolves ConstantsHolder/SchainsInternal via contractManager.
calculateBounty resolves ConstantsHolder, Nodes and TimeHelpers via contractManager.
getAndUpdateLockedAmount resolves controller/time helper contracts via contractManager.
withdrawBounty resolves the SkaleToken address via contractManager.
getBounty invokes _payBounty when a positive bounty is computed.
calculateBounty path interacts with effective delegation updates handled by handleDelegationAdd.
confiscate updates the effective delegated sequence later read by the getter.
withdrawBounty calls getAndUpdateEarnedBountyAmountOf to compute the payout.
withdrawFee relies on the same earned-amount accounting routine.
rotateNode calls selectNodeToGroup to choose the new node.
exitFromSchain calls rotateNode to perform the rotation.
deleteSchain calls schainsInternal.removeNodeFromSchain for every node in the group.
recover uses the ecrecover opcode with malleability range checks.

normalization_plan.reason: validatorId is only meaningful as input to Punisher.slash.
amount is only meaningful as input to Punisher.slash.
holder is only meaningful as input to Punisher.forgive.
contractName is resolved inside the allow modifier guard.
the random accumulator is a temporary local of selectNodeToGroup.
schainId is only meaningful as input to selectNodeToGroup.
newNodeIndex is only meaningful as input to rotateNode.
schainHash is only meaningful as input to removeNodeFromSchain.
nodeIndex is only meaningful as input to removeNodeFromSchain.
to is only meaningful as the transfer destination of withdrawBounty.
validatorId is only meaningful as input to withdrawBounty.
newOwner is only meaningful as input to transferOwnership.
holder is only meaningful as input to TokenLaunchLocker.lock.
amount is only meaningful as input to TokenLaunchLocker.lock.
the local schainId is derived and consumed entirely inside initializeSchain.
signature is only meaningful as input to ECDSA.recover.
